products.name: Presentations.AI
products.note: Text-to-presentation AI; automated layouts; brand templates; content governance

profile_text.body:
Presentations.AI is an AI presentation platform founded by Sumanth Raghavendra, Ravi Kasthuri, and Saravanan Govindaraj, and built by a 30-person team the company describes as bringing two decades of enterprise software experience. The platform accepts a range of inputs, including typed topics, pasted notes, Word documents, PDFs, and URLs, and converts them into structured slide decks with applied layouts, copy, and design. Finished decks can be exported as native .pptx files or to Google Slides, and the platform supports real-time collaboration within a shared workspace. The company describes its user base as founders, sales teams, marketers, product managers, consultants, and trainers, and states it is trusted by 12 million teams.

The core product, also called Presentations.AI, is categorized as a slides and presentations tool and combines text-to-presentation generation, automated layouts, brand templates, and content governance. The platform adjusts its output structure depending on the stated purpose of a deck, such as an investor pitch, a sales deck, or a board presentation. It also offers a slide-by-slide creation mode for users who prefer manual control over individual slides, and a integration path for ChatGPT users who can paste prompts or existing conversations directly into the platform to generate a finished deck.

The held facts contain no litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations associated with Presentations.AI.
